# Weekly sync, 2026-10-13

Attendees: [[Maya Okafor]], [[Tom Lindqvist]], [[Priya Raman]], [[Daniel Reyes]], [[Sofia Marchetti]], [[Kenji Watanabe]]

## Decisions
- SMS reminders move from Vonage to Sinch on 1 November (see [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is Sinch]]).
- Support tool remains Plain for now; Zendesk was not decided and will be revisited in December.

## Discussion
- We launched publicly on 6 October as planned. Early feedback from clinics is good.
- Several receptionists again asked for per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

## Actions
- [[Kenji Watanabe]] to stop the Vonage rollout; that task is no longer needed.
- [[Priya Raman]] to redesign the SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 30 October.

## Week updates
- On 2026-10-14, [[Maya Okafor]] and [[Tom Lindqvist]] agreed to move product analytics to PostHog Cloud in the EU region (see [[Decision - Product analytics vendor is PostHog Cloud EU]]).
- On 2026-10-15, [[Daniel Reyes]] and [[Tom Lindqvist]] decided on Tuesday and Thursday releases behind feature flags (see [[Decision - Release cadence is twice-weekly releases on Tuesdays and Thursdays]]).
- Concierge onboarding is live for all pilot clinics and the help centre is updated; the onboarding rollout task is complete. Day-view dark mode is in beta.
- On 2026-10-16, investor updates returned to monthly while keeping the metrics dashboard link (see [[Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly with metrics dashboard link]]).
- On 2026-10-16, [[Priya Raman]] and [[Kenji Watanabe]] agreed to replace Tailwind UI with shadcn/ui as the design system (see [[Decision - Design system is shadcn ui]]).

# Release cadence: continuous deploys behind feature flags

Decided on 2026-10-04 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **continuous deploys behind feature flags**.

## Why
Weekly batches hid regressions.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Exports to CSV are used weekly by clinic managers for payroll. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Load testing showed the booking endpoint is fine up to 300 requests per second.
